clue.text: Does without police department in crucial encounter

indicators.note: used in its old sense of outside, so the deer go round the other piece

parts.note: does are female deer, so the plural noun gives deer
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police

explanation.surface: Someone manages a decisive showdown without calling in the police.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Does' looks like a verb but is the plural of doe; 'without' is used in its old sense of outside.
explanation.definitionFit: A decider is the deciding game or match that settles a contest, a crucial encounter.

clue.text: Turned Iron Lady outside for slander

indicators.note: the lady stands outside the other piece, enclosing it

parts.note: a dame is a titled lady

indicators.note: the iron symbol is turned round, so read backwards

parts.note: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron

explanation.surface: The Iron Lady was turned out, accused of slander.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Iron Lady' suggests Margaret Thatcher, but splits into two separate pieces; 'Turned' gives EF from the iron symbol.
explanation.definitionFit: To defame is to damage someone's reputation, which is what slander does as a verb.

clue.text: One accountant has daughter pinched by another — a chirpy creature

indicators.note: squeezed between the letters of the other accountant

parts.note: a second chartered accountant, CA
I is the Roman numeral one
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: One accountant's daughter is pinched by another, chirpy as an insect.
explanation.walkthrough: I + CA + D (ICAD) sits inside a second CA: C-ICAD-A.
explanation.definitionFit: The cicada is an insect famous for its loud chirping song.

clue.text: Symptom of middle age providing clue for "toast"?

definitions.meaning: fleshy folds under the jaw that come with age
the toast chin-chin is the word chin doubled

explanation.definitionFit: Read as an instruction, doubling chin gives the toast chin-chin; it is also a sagging fold under the jaw.

clue.text: Had control of Switzerland's agricultural establishment

parts.note: to run something is to control it
CH is the international code for Switzerland

explanation.surface: A Swiss businessman ran a farm.
explanation.definitionFit: A ranch is a large farm for raising livestock, an agricultural establishment.

clue.text: The jumper in the turret?

parts.note: a sleeveless jumper, or whatever sits on top of an armoured vehicle in its turret

explanation.definitionFit: A tank top is a sleeveless knitted jumper; whimsically, the turret is the top of a military tank.

clue.text: Maestro Morrison's about to survey island

indicators.note: the novelist's name is placed about, around, the other pieces

parts.note: Toni Morrison is the American Nobel-winning novelist
to scan is to survey

explanation.surface: Toni Morrison is about to take a look at an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about to' reads as 'soon going to', but 'about' is the container signal and 'to' just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Arturo Toscanini was a famous Italian conductor, a maestro of the orchestra.

clue.text: Drama involving a boatman

indicators.note: the drama takes in the other letter

parts.note: Noh is classical Japanese drama

explanation.surface: A play featuring a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: Noah built the ark in Genesis, so he is the Bible's famous boatman.

clue.text: Cruise, a belligerent sort of missile

parts.note: Tom Cruise is the film actor
a hawk is someone who favours war

explanation.surface: A cruise missile is a warmonger's weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cruise' suggests a cruise missile, but it is the actor Tom Cruise.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tomahawk is a US cruise missile, and a tomahawk is also a throwing axe.

clue.text: Concession about old letter, or announcement of the most recent ones?

definitions.text: announcement of the most recent ones

indicators.note: the concession is turned about, reading backwards

parts.note: a sop is a concession made to placate someone
thorn is the Old English letter for th

explanation.surface: A concession concerning an old letter, or news of the latest ones.
explanation.walkthrough: SOP reversed gives POS, then THORN.
explanation.definitionFit: A coach guard blew the post horn to announce the arrival of the latest mail.

clue.text: "Cape Fear", in cinemas, had umpteen openings

indicators.note: the openings of the five words after Cape are their first letters

explanation.surface: The thriller Cape Fear was showing in many cinemas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cape Fear' looks like the film title, but Cape alone is the definition and the following words give their initials.
explanation.definitionFit: A fichu is a small triangular shawl or cape worn round a woman's shoulders.

clue.text: Many guests, having dropped Ecstasy, developed eye problem

indicators.note: letters that have developed have changed into a new form, signalling rearrangement
the guests have let something fall out of their letters, signalling removal

parts.note: E is the street abbreviation for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A party crowd gave up their ecstasy pills and got an eye complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove E from MANY GUESTS, leaving MANYGUSTS; 'developed' tells you to rearrange those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Nystagmus is a medical condition of involuntary rapid eye movement, so it is an eye problem.

clue.text: Theologian wearing slipper and cape is a numbskull

indicators.note: the slipper is worn by the theologian, so it goes round him

parts.note: a mule is a backless slipper
DD is Doctor of Divinity, a theologian's degree
a cape or headland is a head, as in Beachy Head

explanation.surface: A scholar of divinity in slippers and a cloak is called a fool.
explanation.walkthrough: A mule is a backless slipper, not the animal; 'wearing' means the slipper goes round the theologian.
explanation.definitionFit: A muddlehead is a confused, stupid person, the same as a numbskull.

clue.text: Ruler's quiet sigh of relief

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, so the ruler is the rest

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
ah is the exclamation of relief

explanation.surface: A monarch gives a quiet sigh of relief.
explanation.definitionFit: A shah was the title of the monarch of Iran, a ruler.

clue.text: Lie about receiving German director's directions to Welsh town

indicators.note: the lounging takes the director's name inside

parts.note: to loll is to lie about lazily
Fritz Lang was the German film director of Metropolis
E and N are compass directions, east and north

explanation.surface: A liar's tale about a German director's instructions for a Welsh town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lie about' is one phrase meaning lounge, not a reversal signal; the director's name goes in after the first L.
explanation.definitionFit: Llangollen is a town in north Wales, famous for its international music festival.

clue.text: Vegetable membrane on Bell's creation (the telephone)? Not initially

annotationWithheld.why: Vegetable membrane on Bell's creation (the telephone)? Not initially (11): CAUL (membrane) + (B)LOWER (the telephone, not initially) leaves IF unaccounted for; no blog parse found to explain it
annotationWithheld.clue: Vegetable membrane on Bell's creation (the telephone)? Not initially

clue.text: All for sloths maintaining order in reverse

indicators.note: the sloths hold the other letters inside

parts.note: the unau is the two-toed sloth

indicators.note: the pair of pieces before it is read backwards

parts.note: OM is the Order of Merit

explanation.surface: Everyone backs sloths keeping order backwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in reverse' turns the pair before it, giving NIMO; the unau is a South American sloth few solvers know.
explanation.definitionFit: If everyone is in favour, the vote is unanimous, all for it.

clue.text: It's irrelevant to the professional scholar

definitions.meaning: of merely theoretical interest, of no practical consequence

explanation.definitionFit: Academic means purely theoretical and so irrelevant; a noun for a university scholar.

clue.text: Born to plead for super-market to be set up

parts.note: to beg is to plead

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means written upwards, so reversed

parts.note: Netto was a discount supermarket chain in Britain

explanation.surface: Begging to have a supermarket built from birth.
explanation.walkthrough: NETTO read upwards gives OTTEN; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Begotten means fathered or produced, so born to a parent.

clue.text: It's God's own work to keep mine from crackling

indicators.note: the creation keeps or holds the mine inside it

parts.note: Creation is the work of God in Genesis
a pit is a coal mine

explanation.surface: A religious claim that divine work stops a mine from crackling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It's' and 'from' are linking words; crepitation is a medical term rarely met outside a doctor's notes.
explanation.definitionFit: Crepitation is a medical term for a crackling sound, as of lungs or rubbing bone.

clue.text: Position of mystic meeting transmuting energy into time

indicators.note: changing one thing into another, here one letter for another

parts.note: a seance is a meeting to contact spirits
E is the physics symbol for energy
T is the physics symbol for time

explanation.surface: A medium's gathering changes energy into time.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the E of SEANCE for T.
explanation.definitionFit: A stance is a position or posture, physical or in an argument.

clue.text: Lincoln welcomes revolutionary novelist

indicators.note: Lincoln takes the revolutionary into his name

parts.note: Abe Lincoln, US president
Che Guevara, the Argentine revolutionary

explanation.surface: President Lincoln greets a revolutionary novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Chinua Achebe was the Nigerian novelist who wrote Things Fall Apart.

clue.text: Jones's partner concealing heroin in boat

indicators.note: the partner hides the drug inside his letters

parts.note: the Dow Jones index is named for Charles Dow and Edward Jones
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: Mr Jones's associate smuggles heroin in a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: Dow and Jones founded the Dow Jones stock index; H goes inside DOW.
explanation.definitionFit: A dhow is a lateen-rigged sailing vessel of the Arabian Sea, a kind of boat.

clue.text: Showing what's wrong with "Giant Disco" remix

indicators.note: a remix of a track reworks it, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remix of the song Giant Disco shows what is wrong with it.
explanation.definitionFit: Diagnostic means serving to identify a fault or illness, showing what's wrong.

clue.text: Good optical instrument from the valleys

parts.note: a lens is an optical device

explanation.surface: A fine lens from the valleys.
explanation.definitionFit: Glens are narrow Scottish valleys.

clue.text: Improvise with gold-digger

definitions.meaning: to improvise an accompaniment in music
a woman who exploits men for their money, a seductress

explanation.definitionFit: Vamp means to improvise musically and, as a noun, a predatory seductress.

clue.text: Conned into deal to procure drug

indicators.note: one piece goes into the other

parts.note: to mete is to deal out
had on means deceived, as in having someone on

explanation.surface: A trickster gets into a deal to buy a drug.
explanation.walkthrough: HAD ON goes inside METE: MET-HADON-E; 'to procure' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Methadone is a synthetic opioid drug used to treat heroin addiction.

clue.text: Move unexpectedly, taking nothing from the best room

indicators.note: taking from means removing, so the letter for nothing is lifted out

parts.note: the lounge is the best sitting room of a British home
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Someone darts suddenly, removing nothing from the front room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking ... from' signals removal: take O from LOUNGE.
explanation.definitionFit: To lunge is to make a sudden forward thrust, an unexpected movement.

clue.text: Preserve composition by star

parts.note: to can food is to preserve it
an opus is a musical composition

explanation.surface: A preserved musical work by a star performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Canopus is the second-brightest star in the night sky, in Carina.

clue.text: Unaffected by bad behaviour with wax

parts.note: sin is wicked behaviour
cere is an old word for wax, as in cerecloth

explanation.surface: Someone untouched by misconduct involving wax.
explanation.definitionFit: Sincere means genuine and without pretence, so unaffected in manner.
